Primera B is printed in black font on a white background while Nacional is printed in white font with a blue background.|Primera B Nacional logo.]] The '''2014 Argentine [[Primera B Nacional]]''' was the 29th season of the professional [[football in Argentina|Argentine]] second division. A total of 22 teams competed. For this season, [[Argentine Football Association|AFA]] decided to change the structure in the [[Argentine football league system]], and because of this 10 teams were promoted to [[Argentine Primera División|Primera División]], with no relegations. ==Club information== {| class="wikitable sortable" |- !
